quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Also use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: What does an "End school zone" sign mean?

options.text: The speed limit is now 20 mph.
A reduced speed zone is starting.
More pedestrians may be present.
The reduced speed zone is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: The reduced speed zone is ending.
questions.explanation: Do not drive faster than the school zone speed limit during the times shown. An "End school zone" sign means you are leaving the reduced speed zone.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, what must other drivers account for?

options.text: Trucks need more distance to stop.
Trucks need less distance to stop.
Trucks make less noise.
Trucks travel faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: Trucks need more distance to stop.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay where the truck driver can see you and where you can see traffic ahead.

questions.question: Drivers cannot pass from either side of a ____ centerline.

options.text: Combination solid and broken yellow
Single broken yellow
Double solid yellow
Single broken white

questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no traffic from either direction can cross the center line to pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
It helps you find cities and towns.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It tells you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to potential hazards on or near the road.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving blocks normal traffic flow
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas
When driving in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving blocks normal traffic flow
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly and blocking traffic flow is illegal. You can receive a ticket for driving slower than necessary.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside it.
Let it share half of your lane.
Pass it using the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle with the same road rights as any other vehicle. Give the rider a full lane width so they have room to maneuver safely.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light, who must yield?

options.text: Whoever started moving last
The driver
Whoever is slower
The pedestrian

questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light, with or without a crosswalk.

questions.question: If a driver sees an animal on the roadway, what should they do?

options.text: No special action is needed.
Honk the horn.
Pass as close as possible to the animal.
Be very cautious.

questions.explanation: Be very careful around animals on the road. Pass them slowly to avoid startling or scaring them.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with flashing signals, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train, then speed up.
Do what the car ahead does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing with flashing signals, stop at least 15 feet from the nearest rail. Watch for trains and other warning signs like lowered gates or train sounds.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area of the road:

options.text: You cannot see without turning your head.
Directly behind your vehicle.
You see in your rearview mirror.
You see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are located to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: For a first DUI conviction, you could:

options.text: Lose your license for up to five years.
Take a required public education class about drunk driving dangers.
Drive with a restricted license.
Pay a fine of at least $300.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pay a fine of at least $300.
questions.explanation: First offense DUI penalties include a fine between $300 and $5,000. The amount depends on your blood alcohol concentration level.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to school zones.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about existing or possible driving hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: If you drive in foggy weather:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Turn on your hazard lights.
It is okay to drive at the maximum speed limit.
Do not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when visibility is 500 feet or less. Use low beams in fog or rain. High beams reflect light back into your eyes and make visibility worse.

questions.question: The speed limit is ____ miles per hour when yellow lights are flashing on a school zone speed limit sign.
questions.explanation: When yellow lights are flashing on a school zone sign, or during school zone hours, you must drive no faster than 15 mph.

questions.question: Stress can affect your driving by:

options.text: Lowering your ability to focus on driving.
Decreasing your chances of an accident.
Causing you to fall asleep at the wheel.
Making you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lowering your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Emotions affect your driving ability. If you are worried, excited, afraid, angry, or sad, you may not drive well. Stress reduces your concentration. It is better to wait to drive than to drive while emotionally upset.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: Upcoming intersections.
Road construction.
An upcoming curve in the road.
Changes in traffic lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane of a multilane highway and want to move into the left lane. You should:

options.text: Look in your rearview mirror for traffic behind you before changing lanes.
Look over your left shoulder for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.
Look in your side mirror for traffic and turn on your turn signal.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder toward the lane you want to enter. Make sure no vehicles are there. Always signal before you change lanes.
